sn55.36:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgataṃ attamanā devā sabhāgataṃ kathenti || ||
sn55.36:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.36:1.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.36:1.5: Yā tā devatā Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā ito cutā tatrūpapannā || tāsam evaṃ hoti ||
sn55.36:1.6: Yathārūpena kho mayam Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā tato cutā idhūpapannā || ariyasāvako pi tathārūpena Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti Ehī ti devānaṃ santike ti || || 4.5.
sn55.36:2.1: Puna ca param bhikkhave ariyasāvako Dhamme ||
sn55.36:2.3: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || lape || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.36:2.4: Yā tā devatā ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā ito cutā tatrūpapannā || tāsam evaṃ hoti || ||
sn55.36:2.5: Yatharūpehi kho mayam ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgatā tato cutā idhūpapannā ariyasāvako pi tathārūpehi ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato Ehī ti devānaṃ santike ti || || 7.
sn55.36:2.6: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgatam attamanā devā sabhāgataṃ kathentī
